methodDescriptions.LIFO: Newest inventory is used first. Generally results in higher COGS during inflation.
methodDescriptions.WEIGHTED_AVERAGE: Average cost of all units in inventory. Smooths out cost fluctuations.
methodDescriptions.FEFO: Batches closest to expiry are used first. Best for perishable goods.
